fact: The ten-day agro-hydro-meteorological bulletin of the multidisciplinary working group (GTP), no. 008 of 23 June 2025, published on ANAMET's site, carries a vegetation cover section with Vegetation Condition Index (NDVI-based) maps for the first dekad of June 2025 by prefecture, sourced from FAO GIEWS.
title: Bulletin décadaire d'information agro-hydro-météorologique du GTP, 2025, N° 008
publisher: Agence nationale de la météorologie du Togo (ANAMET), Groupe de travail pluridisciplinaire
